basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Forensic and Medical Jurisprudence, Cross-Sectional Imaging Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rajkot (Gujarat), a Central Autonomous Institute of National Importance under PMSSY, MoH & FW, has invited online applications from Indian citizens for one seat each in the Post-Doctoral Certificate Courses in Forensic and Medical Jurisprudence and Cross-Sectional Imaging (session January 2027). Each course lasts 01 year. The essential qualification is MD/DNB in the concerned subject, the upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date of application, and the pay is Level 11 of the Matrix with entry pay of ₹ 67,700/- per month plus NPA. Pay the application fee online only, using the payment link in the notice: https://erp.eshiksa.net/DirectFeesv3/AIIMSRajkotRecruitment. The fee, once remitted, is not refunded.

Address proof (Ration Card, Passport, Driving License, Aadhar Card etc.)
Certificate showing date of birth (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate)
Class 10th and 12th marksheets and certificates
MBBS and MD/DNB/MS/M.Ch marksheets and certificates
FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign graduate MBBS)
Attempt certificate and internship completion certificate
Registration with Medical Council of India/State Medical Council
Experience certificate
No Objection Certificate (in case of working in government sector)
Publications and any other relevant documents
Candidates who do not produce the original documents at the interview will not be considered for selection.
important_instructions: Candidates in service in any Government institution must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of interview; without it they will not be permitted for the interview. The appointment is full time and private practice of any kind is prohibited. The appointee will have to work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute. No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidate for joining the post. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. False declarations or wilful suppression of material information can lead to removal from service and other action. The competent authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, withdraw the process in full or in part and reject any or all applications without assigning reasons. Any addendum, corrigendum or update will be uploaded only on the AIIMS Rajkot website. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Court of Law at Rajkot (Gujarat).

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Rajkot
content_sections.text: AIIMS Rajkot describes itself on its letterhead as a Central Autonomous Institute of National Importance under PMSSY, MoH & FW, Government of India. Its campus is at Village Khandheri, Tehsil Paddhari, District Rajkot, 360110. The notice is signed by the Dean (Academics).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two courses with one seat each, 2 seats in total. The notice states that no constitutional reservation seats are available or applicable for any seats for any Fellowship courses.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: * DNB in a subject from an Institute or Medical College recognized by MCI/NMC with experience according to NMC Guidelines. The notice reproduces clause 4A of the Minimum Qualifications for Teachers in Medical Institutions (Amendment) Regulations, 2018 on equivalence of DNB with MD/MS: (a) DNB training in an institution which now runs MCI recognized postgraduate degree courses in a given subject: the DNB is at par with the MCI recognized qualification in that subject only. (b) DNB training in a multi-speciality teaching hospital with at least 500 beds, involved in various postgraduate/super-speciality teaching programmes, provided one out of three DNB supervisors qualifies as postgraduate teacher as per MCI norms in his/her previous appointment and one out of the remaining two qualifies as postgraduate teacher as per MCI regulations: considered at par. (c) Three years teaching experience in the subject as Resident/Registrar/Demonstrator/Tutor, or work experience gained during DNB training, in other locations/institutions (100 or more bedded hospitals): one additional year as senior resident in an MCI recognized/permitted institution is required for equivalence. (d) The same three years of experience from an institution not covered in (a) to (c): two additional years as Sr. Resident/Research Associate (CSIR) in an MCI recognised/permitted medical college/institution are required for equivalence. The candidate should pass the qualifying examination by 28 February 2027 and the result should be declared on or before that date. Candidates who have appeared for the exam or viva voce with the result awaited may appear in the theory exam and/or interview provisionally. If the result is declared after 28.02.2027, the candidature stands cancelled. The upper age limit as on the last date of application is 45 years. The notice prints no minimum age. Only Indian citizens are invited to apply. Refer to the official notification for the full eligibility details of each course.

rows.essential_qualification: MD/DNB* in Forensic Medicine and Toxicology from an MCI/NMC recognized Institution
MD/DNB* in Radiology from an MCI/NMC recognized Institution

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay scale is ₹ 18,750 + 6,600 (Grade Pay) + NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance) plus other usual allowance, or revised pay scale as per 7th CPC as applicable: Level 11 of the Matrix (pre-revised PB-3), entry pay of ₹ 67,700/- per month + NPA plus other usual allowance admissible under rules. Course fee: the selected candidate pays ₹ 50,000/- per annum (one time) on the day of admission. Bond: selected candidates execute a bond of ₹ 2,00,000/- on a Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of ₹ 100/- along with 2 sureties. Leave is as per the Senior Residency scheme, MoH & FW, Government of India. The appointment gives no right to claim permanent absorption; the contractual appointment may be renewed or terminated as decided by the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible applicants will be notified to appear in an MCQ-based exam followed by an interview. Candidates are shortlisted in the ratio of 1:6 per vacancy according to marks obtained in the exam. The final criteria give 80% weightage to the examination and 20% to the interview. Appearance in the interview does not entitle a candidate to selection. The date and venue of the exam and interview will be notified on the Institute's website. The list of eligible and subsequently selected candidates will be uploaded on www.aiimsrajkot.edu.in . The notice does not give the exam pattern, marks or duration.

faq.question: Q1. How many seats are available in AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 seats in total: 01 in Forensic and Medical Jurisprudence and 01 in Cross-Sectional Imaging.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date and time of online application is 12 December 2026 (12:00 Hrs).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Forensic and Medical Jurisprudence needs MD/DNB in Forensic Medicine and Toxicology; Cross-Sectional Imaging needs MD/DNB in Radiology, both from an MCI/NMC recognized Institution. The qualifying examination must be passed and the result declared by 28 February 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date of application, relaxable by five years for SC/ST and three years for OBC. For PwBD it is relaxable by ten years (General), thirteen years (OBC) and fifteen years (SC/ST).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General/OBC/EWS pay ₹ 1,000 + 18% GST = 1180, and SC/ST pay ₹ 800 + 18% GST = 944. PwBD candidates pay Nil. Payment is online only and not refunded.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through the Google form link in the notice and pay the fee through the e-payment link. Do not send hard copies; bring a print copy of the application form at document verification.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants appear in an MCQ-based exam followed by an interview. Shortlisting is 1:6 per vacancy by exam marks, and the final weightage is 80% for the exam and 20% for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay?
faq.answer: The pay is Level 11 of the Matrix with entry pay of ₹ 67,700/- per month plus NPA and other usual allowances admissible under rules.

faq.question: Q9. Is a bond required?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates execute a bond of ₹ 2,00,000/- on a Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of ₹ 100/- along with 2 sureties.

faq.question: Q10. Are reserved seats available?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no constitutional reservation seats are available or applicable for any seats for any Fellowship courses.
